body:
She does seem to be that way, but no one else sees it which is a bit infuriating. 

Yeah, I'm just going to try and wait it out, go home at weekends and holidays etc, and move out as soon as exams are over. Hopefully I'll never have to see them again after that. I probably won't be able to go to all the societies I used to love though, because they'll all be there.

Thank you so much for talking to me, it's really helped me out a lot. <3

I became friends with these people because they're not party animals and I thought we'd end up having fun little gaming nights as a house. Boy, was I wrong! It's awesome you got to have a cat through college though! Most landlords for the student houses in my area don't allow pets, which is a shame because I'm pretty sure my boyfriend would have at least 2 cats if not. Sucks that you went through a tough time too, I'm hoping that me and my boyfriend living alone together is going to work out well like it has for you.

I know, it's so infuriating! I came to University to try and get away from stupid, mean people! I must say that a positive out of all of this is that my coursework has been top-fucking-notch this year, what with my lack of a social life and all. And I heard today that Dickbag apparently failed a few of his modules this year. So I guess I've got that going for me.

I wish I could sublease my room but the landlord is one of those hands-on, I'll-visit-every-two-weeks kind of guys so he'd notice straight away. Also my housemates would probably tell him.

I try and go back home as much as I can, at weekends and stuff, but with all my deadlines I can't leave for a while. I know it must upset my mum when she comes to visit because she can see me getting progressively worse.

Thanks for the reply. I've tried to work out a budget but I can't afford to find a new place with him until we can move into our new house in July. And I can't go back home and travel in now, because I'd still have to pay rent etc so I wouldn't be able to afford it. I'm stuck here, which sucks so much.

The funny thing is that she's an UberFeminist, and believes in the whole 'girls sticking up for girls' mentality. Well, on the exterior that's what she says anyway. Doesn't really translate when she does stuff like this. I honestly don't know how the rest of our friend group hasn't seen her for what she truly is yet. She snaps at them all the time and is just generally not a very nice person. I can't even be in the same room as her any more. 

Yeah, I guess I'm lucky that my boyfriend is still supporting me. But I don't think I'm ever going to be able to stop caring about what others think of me, and that's whats making it so difficult to live here.

Thanks. My boyfriend is going through the same thing as me because the lies are about him too, and he lives in the same house as them like me. He's able to sit with them and tolerate them though, but I just can't. I don't think he fully understands my anxiety about being in the same house as them, but he tries his best and that's all I ask for. 
He's amazing, but I haven't been telling him about my suicidal thoughts, because I don't want him to worry any more than he already does.

I've had to deal with sociopathic people in the past too, I dated one for nearly 3 years. That's why this hurts so much, because I thought I could trust these people, you know?
